call_body: plot(x, y, xlab = xlab, ylab = ylab, type = "n", ...)
plot(temp1, temp2, type = "n", axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "", ...)
plot(tree, uniform = TRUE, branch = 0.2, compress = TRUE, margin = 0.1)

plot(1-specificity, sensitivity, type = "o", xlim = c(0, 1),
                 ylim = c(0, 1), ylab = "Sensitivity", xlab = "1-Specificity")

plot(specificity, sensitivity, type = "o", xlim = c(0, 1),
                 ylim = c(0, 1), ylab = "Sensitivity", xlab = "Specificity")

plot(nsplit, 1 - rel.error, xlab = "Number of Splits", ylab = "R-square",
        ylim = c(0, 1), type = "o")

plot(nsplit, 1 - xerror, type = "o", ylim = c(0, 1), lty = 2,
        xlab = " ", ylab = " ")

plot(nsplit, xerror, xlab = "Number of Splits", ylab = "X Relative Error",
        ylim = ylim, type = "o")
